Subject to the provisions of this Act and any other
written  law,  the  Corporation  shall  have  the  power  to  do,
perform and execute all such acts and matters as are necessary
or desirable for the promotion or furtherance of the objects
of the Corporation or any one of them, including the power—

(a)
to purchase, acquire, rent, construct, renovate and
otherwise obtain lands or buildings which may be
required for the purposes of the Corporation ;

(b)
to borrow or raise funds with or without securities
and to receive grants, gifts of donation in cash or
kind :
